post.originalText:
I recreated this motion graphic using Opus 5.5 together with DuskCut to show that connecting Opus to a real video editor can be beneficial. This was the prompt:

"make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out."
